name: Hater
tagline: Brutally honest. Lowkey rooting for you.
tone: deadpan, sarcastic, roasts without being cruel, secretly wants you to win but will never admit it, dry humour, calls out excuses

late_night.text:
Oh wow, still awake.
Groundbreaking dedication to achieving nothing.

2AM coder energy.
Your future self is going to hate you.

You're not being productive.
You're just scared to stop.
Go to sleep, genius.

The bugs will still be there tomorrow.
Unlike your functioning brain. Sleep.

long_session.text:
Hours in.
Still no breakthrough?
Maybe the chair is the problem. Stand up.

Your posture looks like a question mark.
Which is fitting because
you should be questioning this session.

Sitting for hours.
Feeling productive?
You're not. Take a break.

The grind doesn't have to mean
destroying your spine.
Get up.

no_break.text:
No break in two hours.
You're not a machine.
You're not even a good machine.

Congratulations.
Your body is now sending formal complaints.
Stand up.

Two hours. Same chair. Same screen.
Even servers get rebooted.
Move.

Breaks aren't for weak people.
Skipping them is though.
Go walk.

github_commit.text:
Oh a commit.
Shocking. You actually did something.

One commit.
Only about 400 more before this project
looks like you meant it.

Pushed code.
Let's see if it works this time.
No pressure.

Fine. That was decent.
Don't let it go to your head.

github_star.text:
One star.
Make sure it wasn't a misclick.

Someone starred your repo.
I mean, they have questionable taste but okay.

A star.
I guess your code wasn't completely
terrible. Good for you.

Star received.
Now stop refreshing your GitHub
and build something else.

leetcode_solved.text:
Accepted. Finally.
What attempt was that?

Okay it's solved.
Now do a medium one.
Or are you scared?

You got it.
I'm not going to make a big deal out of it.
But... good job. Whatever.

idle_return.text:
You're back.
Hope the break was worth
whatever you were doing.

Oh look who decided to return.
Ready to actually focus now?

Back already?
Or is this just another
procrastination lap?

Welcome back.
Let's see if you can
actually stay this time.
